messages:
Elaine: Proposal for a controlled rollout of 'latency-envelope routing' (steering v3). Objective: swap model variants without introducing tail-latency regressions and keep cost within target. High-level plan:
- Shadow mirror baseline traffic for 24h (no end-user exposure)
- 1% canary to opt-in/low-tier customers for 6h
- Ramp by latency-envelope slices (slice A: p50<100ms, slice B: 100-200ms, slice C: >200ms) with gating checks between ramps
- Flip to full if SLOs stable for continuous 12h

Devin: Sounds good. Add an A/B measurement bucket for quality vs cost. Mirror needs to record p50/p95/p99, error_count, tokens_per_response, and a similarity-based quality score per slice. Also tag traffic with ab_group:control|candidate.

Sam: SRE concerns: need explicit automated rollback and regional fallback rules. My suggested triggers: 
- p95 latency > baseline_p95 + 200ms for >=5m => automatic rollback for that slice
- client_error_rate increase > 0.5% absolute for >=3m => rollback
- cost_per_token climb >10% for >=30m => pause ramp and reroute to previous variant
Additionally: if anomaly is localized to a region, route traffic in that region to the previous variant and open an incident.

Lucy: From Console/UX side: expose canary status and allow early-access customers to opt out. UI elements: small "Early access" badge on routes, per-tenant toggle, and rollout banner on the staged-rollouts page. Also add a dashboard card summarizing per-slice SLOs.

Tao: Data/QC: we should run a scripted eval harness against the top-200 prompts every hour for each candidate. Metrics to capture: semantic_similarity_mean, hallucination_rate, and response_truncation_rate. Alert if semantic_similarity drops >2% relative to control OR hallucination_rate increases by 1.5% absolute. Also sample 1 in 1000 outputs for manual review during canary.

Elaine: Flag naming and tagging proposal: 
- feature flag: feature.routing.latency_envelope.v3
- rollout tags: phase=shadow|canary|slice|full, slice=latency_lt_100|latency_100_200|latency_gt_200
Will coordinate with infra for flag rollouts.

Sam: Draft PromQL (will iterate):
```
# p95 latency over 5m per route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
# error rate over 5m
sum(rate(request_errors_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route)
```
I'll add alert blocks and the runbook for rollback actions.

Devin: Implementation constraints: Hosted mode will be able to auto-rollout. Dedicated clusters require opt-in and Reserved deployments will need admin approval plus a config sync operation. SDK default behaviour remains server-side routing; we'll add a client-side slicing opt-in later. Also note: routing should prefer same-region variants unless capacity triggers cross-region reroutes.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary job queued -> job_id=latency-envelope-canary-20241212-01

- @Devin: implement mirror telemetry + A/B tagging + per-slice metrics (due EOD Wed)
